BiblicalUsage: Mire is the word for mud, and it appears once, in Peter's proverb about the false teachers. In 2 Peter 2:22 it has happened unto them according to the true proverb, the dog is turned to his own vomit again, and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire. One word, for the mud a washed sow runs back to.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mire is the warning in the proverb: washing without a new nature only makes the return to the mud certain.
